name: DropNet
description: Cross-platform offline file transfer application built using Flutter.
shortDescription: Fast and seamless peer-to-peer file sharing without relying on cloud storage.
originStory: DropNet was created because many file transfer solutions either depended on internet connectivity or felt unnecessarily complicated.
technicalOverview: Uses temporary local server architecture, socket communication, peer discovery and direct device-to-device networking concepts.
favoritePart: Designing a seamless file-sharing experience with minimal friction.
lessonsLearned: Networking bugs are usually harder than UI bugs.
Reliable communication is more difficult than it initially appears.
Simple UX often requires complex engineering.
importance: Most important and most representative project.
recruiterPitch: Demonstrates networking, architecture, UI engineering, state management and real-world problem solving.

name: UltraVision
status: In development. Not public yet; it will be made public soon.
description: A Flutter app that runs AI models on the device itself, with a Material 3 Expressive interface. Model weights are not bundled: you download them from the in-app Model Marketplace or import your own files.
shortDescription: On-device AI gallery for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. In development, public soon.
features: Playground with nine Marvel-inspired personas (Human Torch, J.A.R.V.I.S., DUM-E, U, F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., Vision, Ultron, Jocasta), each with its own tone, colour, shape and built-in offline voice
Plain model chat with thinking mode, stats, dictation and read-aloud
Agent Skills: Wikipedia, map cards, visual summaries, calculator, unit converter, photo search, image generation; extra skill packs load from a URL
Instant Media Search: photo search that updates as you type, using CLIP on ONNX Runtime
Video Moment Finder: embeds video frames with CLIP and ranks moments on a heat timeline
Ask Image: ask a vision model about up to 10 images
Audio Scribe: transcribe, summarise, translate or list action items from a recording
Prompt Lab with temperature, top-K and token controls plus TTFT and decode-speed stats
Tiny Garden: a 3x3 garden you tend with natural-language commands through function calls
Device Actions such as flashlight, alarms, calendar events and app launch, with confirmation for risky ones
Enhance & Upscale: on-device photo upscaling (2x/4x), face fix, denoise and repair with a before/after view
Model Marketplace with six categories, RAM-fit hints, resumable SHA-256 verified downloads
originStory: I wanted the AI features people usually rent from a server to run on the phone in your pocket, with the personality of the assistants I grew up watching.
favoritePart: Every persona has its own voice that works offline. DUM-E and U even beep and whirr.
importance: My most ambitious project so far. It is still in development and will be made public soon.
recruiterPitch: Shows on-device ML integration (llama.cpp, CLIP, Whisper, diffusion), multi-platform Flutter architecture and product design at scale.

name: FetchNet
description: A simple cross-platform downloader for video, audio and images, built in Flutter as a graphical interface for the open-source tools yt-dlp and gallery-dl. Paste a link, pick a quality, done.
shortDescription: Flutter front end for yt-dlp and gallery-dl on Android and Windows.
platforms: macOS and Linux build from source (untested on hardware)
features: Paste links from YouTube and the thousands of sites yt-dlp supports; links shared from other Android apps open straight in it
Video from 144p to 4K merged to MP4, or audio as MP3 (320/192/128 kbps), M4A or the original stream
Posts and galleries from Instagram, X, Reddit, Pinterest and more through gallery-dl, sorted into Images, Audio and Video folders
On Android, yt-dlp, Python, FFmpeg and QuickJS are bundled in the app
disclaimer: FetchNet only provides an interface to yt-dlp and gallery-dl. It does not host or distribute media; people should only download content they have the right to.
recruiterPitch: Shows packaging native tooling (Python, FFmpeg) inside a Flutter app and shipping real releases.

name: DropNet-CLI
description: A pure-Python command-line companion to DropNet that sends any file to another device on the same network. No internet, no cloud, no accounts.
shortDescription: Encrypted, verified LAN file transfers from the terminal.
features: Zero-config discovery of receivers on the LAN through a UDP beacon, or send straight to a known IP
Optional end-to-end encryption with a 6-character session code using Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC)
SHA-256 and CRC32 checks on every transfer
Animated progress bars and panels built with rich
Setup checker that detects and fixes the Python installation
recruiterPitch: Shows low-level networking, encryption and integrity checks without a framework.

name: Portfolio Website
description: Personal portfolio website showcasing projects, certifications, experiences and ArijeetOS.
shortDescription: A portfolio designed to feel memorable rather than traditional.
importance: Represents my professional identity and serves as the home of ArijeetOS.
favoritePart: Turning a traditional portfolio into an interactive experience.
originStory: Built because I wanted visitors to interact with my work instead of simply reading about it.
specialFeature: Contains ArijeetOS, an interactive digital consciousness experience.
recruiterPitch: Demonstrates creativity, frontend engineering and user experience design.
